children: With the proposed proceeds from selling stake in IDBI Bank, the amount under ‘Miscellaneous Capital Receipts (MCR) is set to exceed the budget estimates for Fiscal Year 2026-27. Also, the proceeds from disinvestment will be the highest after 2018-19 and if minority stake sale in CPSEs continue, it could exceed ₹1 lakh crore, for the second time between 2014-15 and now.

What is significant is that this mop up will provide relief to government finances at a time when collections from excise are set to be down while expenditure on subsidy and on other welfare scheme is set to go up.  “This completion was hanging for five  years. The Cabinet decision has to be honoured. This decision is not solely aimed at boosting government finances but certainly, it will help the exchequer,” a top government official told businessline.
The term ‘Disinvestment’ is now out from the budget

title: IDBI Bank stake sale to push MCR receipts beyond ₹90,000 crore, providing fiscal relief
